title: Ek kambal se PIR sensor ko bewakoof banao 🤯 #shorts
description:
PIR sensor dekhta nahi, sirf garmi ka change pakadta hai.
Shisha uski infrared rok deta hai, isliye sensor chup ho jaata hai.
🔥 HC-SR501 ke andar do hisse hote hain
🪟 Glass 8–14 µm IR rokta hai
⏱️ Power-up ke baad 60 s output ignore karo
💾 Apne Arduino project ke liye save karo
Echo Lab 3D ko subscribe karo, har hafte ek module kholke dekhenge!
